description: This PHP source file defines the Currency controller class for the OpenCart admin panel. It provides methods to generate, list, refresh, and clear currency data and files, interacting with models and language files, and managing currency-related tasks within the system.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Controller class for managing currency data and operations in the OpenCart admin system.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes currency tasks by adding clear and list tasks to the system.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Generates a JSON file containing currency data and saves it in the specified directory.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes currency values by calling the appropriate extension controller and scheduling an update task.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes existing JSON currency files for all languages.
